explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/123 with the reported positive resolution. For pairwise coprime a, b, c > 1, the set {a^k b^l c^m} (as a product of Submonoid.powers) is d-complete: every large integer is a sum of distinct elements forming a divisibility antichain. Distinctness of a, b, c is automatic from coprimality with all > 1.
